news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% year-over-year to $1.9 million with gross margin expanding roughly 230 basis points, and cash on hand was $8.3 million as of June 30, 2026 after raising about $2.5 million through the ATM facility, warrant exercises, and lower operating cash outflows.

news.headline: NeurAxis (NYSE American: NRXS) doubles sales yet warns on going concern
news.summary: Despite record revenue growth, NeurAxis's Q2 2026 filing continues to carry a going-concern qualification tied to ongoing operating losses and reliance on external financing, though management said larger payer/customer wins expected in the second half of 2026 into 2027 should improve that outlook.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy representing over 500,000 covered lives, expanding incremental access for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results (period ended June 30, 2026) before market open on August 11, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00 am ET the same day.

news.headline: NeurAxis Files Form S-3 Resale Registration Statement
news.summary: NeurAxis filed an S-3 registering the resale of 1,923,194 shares of common stock by selling stockholders/directors (999,418 resale shares plus 923,776 shares underlying RSUs), a technical filing that creates potential future selling pressure but is not itself a capital raise.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Series B Preferred Stock Dividend
news.summary: The Board approved a Q2 2026 stock dividend on Series B Preferred Stock, to be paid entirely in common shares (approximately 80,463 shares at a $2.38 calculation rate) on July 29, 2026 to holders of record as of July 21, 2026.

catalysts.label: Larger customer/payer wins expected to address going concern
catalysts.detail: On the Q2 2026 earnings call management said it expects to sign larger customers in the second half of 2026 into 2027, which it believes will materially change the company's going-concern outlook disclosed in its filings.

catalysts.label: Continued payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Company continues to add regional/national medical policy coverage decisions for PENFS/IB-Stim (most recently 500k+ covered lives in the Mid-Atlantic on Aug 4, 2026), building on the Category I CPT code (effective Jan 1, 2026) that has already unlocked over 50 million covered lives nationally.

catalysts.label: Cash-flow breakeven target
catalysts.detail: Management continues to guide to roughly $15M in annualized revenue needed for cash-flow breakeven, alongside a targeted burn rate of about $1M/quarter or less; Q2 2026 cash on hand was $8.3M after $2.5M raised via ATM issuance and warrant exercises.

catalysts.label: RED (Rectal Expulsion Device) and VA channel ramp
catalysts.detail: Commercialization of the RED chronic-constipation device continues alongside the VA Federal Supply Schedule contract (effective Dec 2025, VA sales launched Jan 2026); management has said VA adoption is running ahead of initial expectations, making the pace of RED/VA revenue contribution a swing factor for 2026 growth.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Based on the company's quarterly reporting cadence, Q3 2026 results would be expected around mid-November 2026; no date has been officially announced yet.

pulse: NeurAxis posted a record Q2 2026 (reported Aug 11): revenue grew 116% YoY to $1.9M with gross margin expanding further, though the going-concern qualification from its filings persists, and management points to larger customer/payer wins expected in H2 2026 into 2027 as the path to resolving it. IB-Stim keeps adding payer coverage (latest Mid-Atlantic policy expansion Aug 4, 500k+ lives) on top of the Category I CPT code that has unlocked 50M+ covered lives nationally, while the RED device and VA Federal Supply Schedule channel continue to ramp ahead of initial expectations. A Series B preferred stock dividend paid in shares (Jul 29) and a new S-3 resale registration (Jul 23) both add modest incremental share-count/overhang alongside the existing ATM facility, keeping dilution a live but non-dramatic risk as the company works toward its ~$15M revenue cash-flow-breakeven target.
